Catalan

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central, Balearic) [ˈsar.də]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [ˈsaɾ.ða]
  • Audio (Valencia):(file)

Etymology 1

[edit]

See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.

Adjective

[edit]

sarda f sg

  1. feminine singular of sard

Noun

[edit]

sarda f (plural sardes)

  1. female equivalent of sard

Etymology 2

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin sarda.

Noun

[edit]

sarda f (plural sardes)

  1. European pilchard (Sardina pilchardus)
    Synonym: sardina

Further reading

[edit]
  • “sarda”, in Diccionari de la llengua catalana [Dictionary of the Catalan Language] (in Catalan), second edition, Institute of Catalan Studies [Catalan: Institut d'Estudis Catalans], April 2007
  • “sarda” in Diccionari català-valencià-balear, Antoni Maria Alcover and Francesc de Borja Moll, 1962.

Italian

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈsar.da/
  • Rhymes: -arda
  • Hyphenation: sàr‧da

Etymology 1

[edit]

From Latin sardina.

Noun

[edit]

sarda f (plural sarde)

  1. (zoology, ichthyology) sardine
    Synonyms: sardella, sardina

Etymology 2

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

sarda f (plural sarde)

  1. female equivalent of sardo

Latin

[edit]

Etymology 1

[edit]

Seemingly ultimately from Ancient Greek Σαρδώ (Sardṓ, “Sardinia”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • sarda:
    • (Classical Latin) IPA(key): [ˈsar.da]
    • (modern Italianate Ecclesiastical) IPA(key): [ˈsar.da]

Noun

[edit]

sarda f (genitive sardae); first declension

  1. A kind of fish, perhaps sardine or mackerel.
    Synonym: sardīna
  2. A kind of stone, probably carnelian.
    Synonym: sardius
Declension
[edit]

First-declension noun.

singular plural
nominative sarda sardae
genitive sardae sardārum
dative sardae sardīs
accusative sardam sardās
ablative sardā sardīs
vocative sarda sardae

Etymology 2

[edit]

From sardus (“Sardinian”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • sarda:
    • (Classical Latin) IPA(key): [ˈsar.da]
    • (modern Italianate Ecclesiastical) IPA(key): [ˈsar.da]
  • sardā:
    • (Classical Latin) IPA(key): [ˈsar.daː]
    • (modern Italianate Ecclesiastical) IPA(key): [ˈsar.da]

Adjective

[edit]

sarda

  1. inflection of sardus:
    1. nominative/vocative feminine singular
    2. nominative/accusative/vocative neuter plural

Adjective

[edit]

sardā

  1. ablative feminine singular of sardus
